```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(osmdata)
library(osmextract)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(units)
library(lwgeom)

votes <- read.csv("data/resultats-detailles-2025.csv")

votes <- votes %>% 
  filter(Poste == "0,00") 

votes <- votes %>% 
  mutate(CODE_SECT = paste0(ifelse(str_length(ElectoralDistrictID) > 2, ElectoralDistrictID, paste0("0", ElectoralDistrictID)), "-", Bureau))

votes <- votes %>% 
  mutate(`Candidate and Party` = paste0(Candidat, " ", Partie))

votes_candidate <- votes %>% 
  select(Votes, TotalValidVotes, CODE_SECT, `Candidate and Party`, District) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Candidate and Party`, values_from = Votes, id_cols = CODE_SECT)


votes_candidate <- votes %>% 
  distinct(CODE_SECT, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  
  select(CODE_SECT, TotalValidVotes, District)  %>% 
  left_join(., votes_candidate, by = "CODE_SECT")

votes_candidate <- votes_candidate %>% 
mutate(across(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`, \(x)round((x / TotalValidVotes)*100)))

winner <- votes_candidate %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`),
               names_to = "Canadidate and Party",
               values_to = "Percentage") %>% 
  group_by(CODE_SECT) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = Percentage, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

winner <- votes_candidate %>% 
  select(CODE_SECT, `DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`) %>% 
  left_join(winner, .,  by = "CODE_SECT")

winner <- winner %>% 
  mutate(across(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`, \(x)paste0(x, "%")))


winner <- winner %>% 
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = replace(`Canadidate and Party`, TotalValidVotes == 0, NA),
        `Canadidate and Party` = case_match(`Canadidate and Party`, 
                                             "RABOUIN Luc Projet Montréal - Équipe Luc Rabouin" ~ "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin",
                                             "MARTINEZ FERRADA Soraya Ensemble Montréal - Équipe Soraya" ~ "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada",
                                             "THIBODEAU Gilbert Action Montréal - Équipe Gilbert Thibodeau" ~ "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau",
                                             "DUVAL Jean Indépendant" ~ "Indépendant: Jean Duval",
                                             "SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé" ~ "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé",
                                             "KACOU Jean-François Futur Montréal" ~ "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou",
                                             "LE ROUGETEL Katy Indépendant" ~ "Indépendant: Katy Le Rougetel"
                                             ))


winner <- winner %>% 
  rename( "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin" = "RABOUIN Luc Projet Montréal - Équipe Luc Rabouin",
           "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada" = "MARTINEZ FERRADA Soraya Ensemble Montréal - Équipe Soraya",
           "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau" = "THIBODEAU Gilbert Action Montréal - Équipe Gilbert Thibodeau",
           "Indépendant: Jean Duval" = "DUVAL Jean Indépendant",
           "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé" = "SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé",
           "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou" = "KACOU Jean-François Futur Montréal",
          "Indépendant: Katy Le Rougetel" = "LE ROUGETEL Katy Indépendant")

test <- winner %>% 
  filter(`Canadidate and Party` == "Indépendant: Jean Duval")

shp <- st_read("data/section-vote-2025/section-vote-2025.shp")

votes_candidate <- shp %>% 
  left_join(votes_candidate, by = "CODE_SECT")

shp <- shp %>% 
  left_join(winner, by = "CODE_SECT")
shp <- shp %>% 
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = replace(`Canadidate and Party`, is.na(`Canadidate and Party`), "No Votes"))
```

library(cancensus)
csd_codes <- c(
  "2466023", "2466007", "2466032", "2466047", "2466058",
  "2466062", "2466072", "2466087", "2466092", "2466097",
  "2466102", "2466107", "2466112", "2466117", "2466127", "2466142"
)
# Montreal CSD (Census Subdivision)
mtl_csd <- get_census(
  dataset = "CA21",
  regions = list(CSD = csd_codes),  # Montreal city
  level = "CSD",
  geo_format = "sf"
)

montreal_island <- st_union(mtl_csd$geometry)

cycleways_Montreal <- readRDS("data/cycleways_Montreal.rds")
bike_lanes <- readRDS("data/bike_lanes.rds")

cycleways_Montreal = cycleways_Montreal %>% 
  mutate(
    tags_list = str_split(other_tags, ',') %>%
      map(~str_replace_all(.x, '"', '')) %>%
      map(~str_trim(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tags_kv = map(tags_list, ~setNames(
      str_extract(.x, '(?<==>).*'),
      str_extract(.x, '^[^=]+')
    ))
  )
cycleways_Montreal <- cycleways_Montreal %>% 
  mutate(
    cycleway       = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway"] %||% NA_character_),
    cycleway_left  = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway:left"] %||% NA_character_),
    cycleway_right = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway:right"] %||% NA_character_)
  )

bike <- cycleways_Montreal# %>%
  # filter(
  #   highway == "cycleway" |
  #     cycleway %in% c("lane","track") |
  #     cycleway_left %in% c("lane","track") |
  #     cycleway_right %in% c("lane","track")
  # )

bike <- st_transform(bike, st_crs(montreal_island))

bike_mtl <- st_intersection(bike, montreal_island)

bike_lanes <- st_transform(bike_lanes, st_crs(montreal_island))

bike_lanes_mtl <- st_intersection(bike_lanes, montreal_island)

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# On-street parking spots, estimated in parking_spots.R

parking <- readRDS("data/parking_spots.rds") %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(shp))

# Assign each curb stretch (by a point on it) and paid spot to a polling district
parking_district <- parking %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_join(shp %>% select(CODE_SECT), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(CODE_SECT)) %>%
  group_by(CODE_SECT) %>%
  summarise(
    free_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Free"]),
    permit_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Permit"]),
    paid_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Paid"]),
    # Share of the district's curbs in boroughs without a complete sign inventory
    no_sign_data = sum(usable_length[parking_type == "No sign data"]) /
      sum(usable_length[parking_type != "Paid"])
  )

shp <- shp %>%
  left_join(parking_district, by = "CODE_SECT") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(free_spots, permit_spots, paid_spots), \(x) replace_na(x, 0)),
    no_sign_data = replace_na(no_sign_data, 0),
    parking_summary = ifelse(
      no_sign_data > 0.5,
      paste0("Free: <span style='color:#999'>no sign data for this borough</span><br>",
             "Permit: <span style='color:#999'>no sign data for this borough</span><br>"),
      paste0("Free: <strong>", format(free_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong><br>",
             "Permit: <strong>", format(permit_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong><br>")
    ),
    parking_summary = paste0(parking_summary,
                             "Paid: <strong>", format(paid_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong>")
  )

parking <- parking %>%
  filter(parking_type != "No sign data") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

```


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| column: screen-inset
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

shp_proj <- st_transform(shp, 3857)
bike_proj <- st_transform(bike_mtl, 3857)
green_lanes <- st_transform(green_lanes, 3857)
bike_proj <- st_cast(bike_proj, "LINESTRING")

# Unbuffered district outlines, kept for drawing the map
district_outlines <- st_geometry(shp_proj)

# Small buffer around each district to capture lines along boundaries
shp_buffered <- st_buffer(shp_proj, 1)  # 1 meter buffer

# Compute bike length (km) per district
shp_proj <- shp_buffered %>%
  mutate(
    bike_km = map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(shp_buffered)), function(j) {
      district_geom <- shp_buffered[j, ]

      # Select lines that intersect this district (buffered)
      hits <- st_intersects(bike_proj, district_geom, sparse = FALSE)
      lines_in_district <- bike_proj[hits[,1], ]

      if (nrow(lines_in_district) == 0) return(0)

      # Clip the lines to the polygon
      clipped <- st_intersection(lines_in_district, district_geom)
      sum(as.numeric(st_length(clipped))) / 1000
    })
  )

# Flag whether each district contains a green lane
shp_proj <- shp_proj %>%
  mutate(has_green = lengths(st_intersects(shp_proj, green_lanes)) > 0)

shp <- shp_proj

# Popups are built in the browser (onRender below) from these columns rather
# than embedding a finished HTML string for every district, which roughly
# doubled the size of the page. Candidates are listed in popup order.
popup_candidates <- c(
  "Indépendant - Jean Duval" = "Indépendant: Jean Duval",
  "Futur Montréal - Jean-François Kacou" = "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou",
  "Ensemble Montréal - Soraya Martinez Ferrada" = "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada",
  "Projet Montréal - Luc Rabouin" = "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin",
  "Indépendant - Katy Le Rougetel" = "Indépendant: Katy Le Rougetel",
  "Transition Montréal - Craig Sauvé" = "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé",
  "Action Montréal - Gilbert Thibodeau" = "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau"
)

popup_data <- shp %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    district = District,
    sect = CODE_SECT,
    winner = as.character(`Canadidate and Party`),
    bike_km = round(bike_km, 2),
    green = has_green,
    free = free_spots,
    permit = permit_spots,
    paid = paid_spots,
    no_sign = no_sign_data > 0.5
  ) %>%
  as.list()
popup_data$votes <- unname(lapply(popup_candidates, \(col) shp[[col]]))
popup_data$candidates <- names(popup_candidates)


# Each winner's party colour, in the order the legend lists them. Ensemble
# uses the pink of Soraya Martinez Ferrada's campaign; the other parties use
# Wikipedia's colours for the 2025 election. Futur Montréal's branding is
# also blue, so it gets a light blue to stay distinct from Projet; independents
# are shades of grey.
party_colours <- c(
  "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada" = "#E6007E",
  "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin" = "#1C4E8E",
  "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé" = "#FF4F19",
  "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou" = "#4FB3E8",
  "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau" = "#88C812",
  "Indépendant: Katy Le Rougetel" = "#A6A6A6",
  "Indépendant: Jean Duval" = "#6E6E6E",
  "No Votes" = "#E0E0E0"
)

# The map is drawn from shp_proj, so the factor has to be set there
shp_proj <- shp_proj %>%
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = factor(`Canadidate and Party`,
                                         levels = names(party_colours)))

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = unname(party_colours),
  levels = names(party_colours),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Legend lists only the winners that appear on the map, in factor order
legend_parties <- levels(droplevels(shp_proj$`Canadidate and Party`))

pal_parking <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#00e5ff", "#ffd700", "#ff00ff"),
  domain = c("Free", "Permit", "Paid")
)

# pal_bike <- colorFactor(
#   domain = bike_lanes_mtl$cycleway,
#   palette = c("green", "blue", "orange", "red", "white")
# )
bike_proj <- st_transform(bike_proj, crs = 4326)
green_lanes <- st_transform(green_lanes, crs = 4326)
shp_proj <- st_transform(shp_proj, crs = 4326)

# Keep the page small: draw simplified district outlines (shared borders stay
# aligned) and round all coordinates to 5 decimals (~1 m)
st_geometry(shp_proj) <- district_outlines %>%
  rmapshaper::ms_simplify(keep = 0.2, keep_shapes = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

round_coords <- function(x) {
  st_geometry(x) <- st_geometry(x) %>%
    st_set_precision(1e5) %>%
    st_as_binary() %>%
    st_as_sfc(crs = 4326)
  x
}

shp_proj <- round_coords(shp_proj)
bike_proj <- round_coords(bike_proj)
green_lanes <- round_coords(green_lanes)

# The parking layer (~100,000 curb stretches and paid spots) is too big to
# embed in the page, so it goes in its own file that the map only downloads
# when the Parking layer is switched on. Coordinates are stored as integers
# (1e-5 degrees, ~1 m) and each vertex as the change from the previous one,
# which keeps most numbers to 1-3 digits.
delta_encode <- function(xy) {
  ints <- round(xy * 1e5)
  as.integer(t(rbind(ints[1, ], diff(ints))))
}

encode_lines <- function(x) {
  xy <- st_coordinates(x)
  rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(xy)), xy[, "L1"])
  list(
    n = x$n_spots,
    c = unname(lapply(rows, \(i) delta_encode(xy[i, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE])))
  )
}

dir.create("files/data", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
jsonlite::write_json(
  list(
    free = encode_lines(filter(parking, parking_type == "Free")),
    permit = encode_lines(filter(parking, parking_type == "Permit")),
    paid = delta_encode(st_coordinates(filter(parking, parking_type == "Paid")))
  ),
  "files/data/montreal_parking.json",
  auto_unbox = FALSE
)


# Fill most of the browser window instead of leaflet's default 400px
election_map <- leaflet(shp_proj, width = "100%", height = "85vh") |>
  addTiles() |>
    addFullscreenControl() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(`Canadidate and Party`),
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
    # Row in popup_data, used by onRender to build this district's popup
    options = pathOptions(row = seq_len(nrow(shp_proj)) - 1),
    group = "Electoral Districts"
  ) |>
  #    addPolylines(
  #   data = bike_mtl,
  #   color = "darkgreen",
  #   weight = 2,
  #   opacity = 0.9,
  #   group = "Bike Lanes"
  # ) |>
    addPolylines(
    data = bike_proj,
    color = "white",
    #label = ~paste(cycleway),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    group = "Bike Lanes"
  ) |>
    addPolygons(
    data = green_lanes,
    color = "green",
    fillColor = "green",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste("Open to traffic:", Open_to_traffic),
    group = "Green Lanes"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    colors = unname(party_colours[legend_parties]),
    labels = legend_parties,
    opacity = 0.8,
    title = "Party"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomleft",
    pal = pal_parking,
    values = c("Free", "Permit", "Paid"),
    title = "Parking",
    group = "Parking"
  ) %>%
   addLayersControl(
     overlayGroups = c("Electoral Districts", "Bike Lanes", "Green Lanes", "Parking"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
   hideGroup(c(
    "Bike Lanes",
    "Green Lanes",
    "Parking"
  )) %>%
  onRender(r"{
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var d = data.popup;
      var active = {};
      var grey = function(s) { return '<span style="color:#999">' + s + '</span>'; };
      var num = function(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); };

      // District popup: the results, plus a section for each overlay that's on
      function popupHtml(i) {
        var html = '<b>District:</b> ' + d.district[i] + '<br>' +
          '<b>Polling Station:</b> ' + d.sect[i] + '<br>' +
          '<b>Winner:</b> ' + d.winner[i] + '<br>';
        d.candidates.forEach(function(name, k) {
          html += '<b>' + name + ':</b> ' + d.votes[k][i] + '<br>';
        });
        if (active['Bike Lanes']) {
          var km = d.bike_km[i];
          html += '<hr><strong>🚲 Bike lanes</strong><br>' + (km === 0 ? grey('0 km') :
            '<strong>' + (km < 0.01 ? '< 0.01' : km) + ' km of bike lanes</strong>');
        }
        if (active['Green Lanes']) {
          html += '<hr><strong>🌿 Green lane in district</strong><br>' +
            (d.green[i] ? '<strong>Yes</strong>' : grey('No'));
        }
        if (active['Parking']) {
          html += '<hr><strong>🅿️ On-street parking spots (est.)</strong><br>' +
            (d.no_sign[i] ?
              'Free: ' + grey('no sign data for this borough') + '<br>' +
              'Permit: ' + grey('no sign data for this borough') + '<br>' :
              'Free: <strong>' + num(d.free[i]) + '</strong><br>' +
              'Permit: <strong>' + num(d.permit[i]) + '</strong><br>') +
            'Paid: <strong>' + num(d.paid[i]) + '</strong>';
        }
        return html;
      }

      // Bound once; the popup is rebuilt each time it opens
      map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('Electoral Districts').eachLayer(function(layer) {
        layer.bindPopup(function(l) { return popupHtml(l.options.row); },
                        { closeOnClick: false });
      });

      // Parking is fetched from its own file the first time it's switched on
      var parkingLoaded = false;
      function decode(a) {
        var pts = [], lng = 0, lat = 0;
        for (var j = 0; j < a.length; j += 2) {
          lng += a[j]; lat += a[j + 1];
          pts.push([lat / 1e5, lng / 1e5]);
        }
        return pts;
      }
      function loadParking() {
        parkingLoaded = true;
        var group = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('Parking', true);
        var renderer = L.canvas({ padding: 0.5 });
        fetch('files/data/montreal_parking.json')
          .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
          .then(function(p) {
            [['free', 'Free'], ['permit', 'Permit']].forEach(function(t) {
              var lines = p[t[0]];
              lines.c.forEach(function(a, j) {
                L.polyline(decode(a), { color: data.colours[t[1]], weight: 2,
                                        opacity: 0.9, renderer: renderer })
                  .bindTooltip(t[1] + ': ' + lines.n[j] + ' spots', { sticky: true })
                  .addTo(group);
              });
            });
            decode(p.paid).forEach(function(pt) {
              L.circleMarker(pt, { radius: 2, stroke: false, fillColor: data.colours.Paid,
                                   fillOpacity: 0.9, renderer: renderer })
                .bindTooltip('Paid: 1 spot')
                .addTo(group);
            });
          })
          .catch(function() { parkingLoaded = false; });
      }

      map.on('overlayadd', function(e) {
        active[e.name] = true;
        if (e.name === 'Parking' && !parkingLoaded) loadParking();
      });

      map.on('overlayremove', function(e) {
        active[e.name] = false;
      });
    }
  }", data = list(
    popup = popup_data,
    colours = as.list(setNames(pal_parking(c("Free", "Permit", "Paid")),
                               c("Free", "Permit", "Paid")))
  ))

# Write at most 5 decimals to the page (coordinates are already rounded)
attr(election_map$x, "TOJSON_ARGS") <- list(digits = 5, use_signif = FALSE)
election_map

  
```
